What is Proton
Proton is a Swiss technology company founded by scientists from CERN .
Its mission is to build digital tools focused on privacy, encryption and data protection .
All Proton services are built with end-to-end encryption and hosted in Switzerland, a country known for strong privacy laws.
The Proton ecosystem includes:
- Proton Mail for Business

- Proton VPN for Business

- Proton Pass for Business

- Proton Drive for Business

Together, these services provide a complete security stack for organizations.
Proton Mail for Business
Proton Mail is an encrypted email platform designed for professional communication.
Key features include:
- end-to-end encrypted email

- protection against email tracking

- custom domains for companies

- administrative controls for teams

- strong privacy protection

Many startups, law firms and consulting companies use Proton Mail to protect sensitive communications.
